levels.label: Synthetic browser fixture
levels.allowed_claim: The self-contained fixture exposes a semantic seat-preference target, a harmless reversible select, and a deliberate stale-target mutation.
levels.forbidden_inference: The fixture is a real booking, account, payment, or provider session.

levels.label: Typed control contract
levels.status_display: Source quality gate passed on dirty checkout
levels.allowed_claim: The current source checkout passes lint, typecheck, tests, build, and MCP smoke, and exposes typed observe, plan, approval, apply, verify, and rollback surfaces.
levels.forbidden_inference: A dirty source checkout is a clean release revision or installed-provider proof.

levels.label: Approval and stale-state safety
levels.status_display: Contract and negative case; installed receipt open
levels.allowed_claim: The fixture and source contract define exact approval, semantic-target binding, single-use apply, fresh verify, and target_changed refusal before mutation.
levels.forbidden_inference: The connected browser has exercised approval, apply, verify, or stale refusal.

levels.label: Installed round trip
levels.allowed_claim: The installed doctor probe reached the configured provider but failed response-schema validation before an observation or plan receipt.
levels.forbidden_inference: The installed extension observed a page, produced a valid plan, or applied a mutation.

levels.label: Local material package
levels.status_display: Synthetic case, short copy, preview, and no-auth page source
levels.allowed_claim: A local candidate packet contains the synthetic case story, claim ledger, reviewed 16:9 preview, short description, and no-auth page source.
levels.forbidden_inference: The page is hosted, public, or posted to a destination.
